summary: Comprehensive feature categorization for Minecraft client-server implementation

core.description: World map control synchronization between client and server
core.implementation_notes: Profile-based control with hash validation, config hot-reload support, chunk caching with budget enforcement

core.description: Advanced terrain generation with hydrology-aware algorithms
core.implementation_notes: Hydrology-aware generation with 100+ configurable parameters, edge sealing for chunk boundaries, support pillars for structural integrity
Chunk load/unload with reasons, ChunkData with compression, tile entity support

core.description: Player state management and authentication system
core.implementation_notes: Authentication messages, PlayerInfo with full state (health, hunger, experience), session management
EntityData with full state, entity spawn/despawn with reasons, multiple entity types (mobs, items, projectiles)

core.description: Player inventory management and item handling
core.implementation_notes: Full inventory structure (main, hotbar, armor, offhand), ItemStack with enchantments and NBT data
Multiple crafting types (2x2, 3x3, furnace, etc.), recipe discovery broadcasts
Combat events with damage types, death events with drops, knockback and critical hits
Achievement unlock broadcasts, statistic tracking by category

core.description: World state synchronization between client and server
core.implementation_notes: Excellent client-server synchronization, comprehensive profile management with hash validation

core.description: Network packet handling and protocol management
core.implementation_notes: Comprehensive protocol with 823-line enhanced protocol, proper packet dispatching
Session creation, maintenance, and cleanup, player state tracking

core.description: Block placement, destruction, and state management
core.implementation_notes: Block break/place with progress tracking, block change broadcasts with reasons, face and cursor position support
Position updates, collision detection, velocity handling
Statistic tracking by category, PlayerStats tracking

content.implementation_notes: Biome types and climate parameters, temperature and humidity zones
Weather system with types (rain, snow, clear), weather transitions
Time updates, day/night cycle, lighting changes
Hunger and saturation tracking, food consumption, starvation effects
Enchantment types and levels, enchantment table mechanics
Particle effects with types, particle spawning and management
Sound effects with categories, sound playback and management
Needs implementation: mob types, spawn conditions, AI behavior
In development: trees, ores, dungeons, villages
Future feature: redstone components, signal propagation, circuit logic

util.implementation_notes: DataDrivenConfigManager exists, WorldGenerationConfig loads from JSON, WorldMapControlProfile loads from JSON
Needs implementation: metrics collection, performance profiling, diagnostic endpoints
ProtocolRegistry exists, DummyProtocolClient exists for protocol testing, supports packet validation, network probing capability, JSON report generation
Logging to file and console, log levels, log rotation
Debug commands, debug UI, inspection tools
FPS tracking, memory usage, server load monitoring
Future feature: code execution time tracking, hotspot identification
JSON serialization, binary serialization, protobuf integration

util.description: Data compression for network and storage
util.implementation_notes: GZIP compression, LZ4 compression, chunk data compression
String helpers, math functions, collection utilities
Input validation, data validation, range checking
Perlin noise, simplex noise, vector math, quaternion math
A* pathfinding, navigation mesh, obstacle avoidance

util.description: AI behavior and decision making utilities
util.implementation_notes: Behavior trees, state machines, decision trees
Packet utilities, connection helpers, network statistics
UI helpers, common UI components, UI event handling
Asset loading, asset caching, asset bundles

notes: This comprehensive feature categorization covers all major Minecraft-like game features. The project is in excellent condition with production-ready terrain generation, comprehensive protobuf protocol, and solid architecture. Most core features are stable and implemented. Priority areas for future work include mob spawning system, structure generation completion, and telemetry/diagnostics implementation.
